thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — runtime_alert: us-west-2 inference runtime queue depth spike. p95 latency 2.1s, p99 4.7s, inflight 3500. Potential SLO breach. Incident RIN-2026-507654. @mira @sam please take.

mira: ack — I'm on it. Can someone dump live queue metrics + top tenants? Also tagging @dana to prep customer comms.

sam: dumping... top tenants by qps: tenant-alpha 42%, tenant-beta 19%, tenant-gamma 6%. avg seq len trending +40% last 15m. queue depth per-host: [420, 380, 610, 8000 on host-07]. host-07 is saturated (GPU 98% mem). Errors: increased 504s on host-07.

ben: hypothesis: a few noisy tenant bursts + large seq lengths filled KV cache causing eviction thrash -> longer token generation times -> queueing overflow. Immediate mitigations I can try now: a) reduce max_inflight on host pool for us-west-2 from 128 -> 48; b) enable soft-shedding for low-priority lanes; c) apply tenant-level ratecap for tenant-alpha to 15 rps. Which do you want first?

mira: do flow control changes in this order: 1) tenant-level ratecap for top noisy tenant, 2) reduce max_inflight, 3) enable soft-shed. Tell me exact commands and I'll run.

ben: runbook commands:
```
# set tenant ratecap
curl -X POST https://admin-api.redwood/api/v1/tenants/tenant-alpha/ratecap -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"rps":15}'

# set runtime max inflight for us-west-2 pool
curl -X POST https://admin-api.redwood/api/v1/runtime/pools/us-west-2/max_inflight -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"max_inflight":48}'

# enable soft-shed for low-priority lanes
curl -X POST https://admin-api.redwood/api/v1/runtime/policies/soft_shed -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"enabled":true,"priority_threshold":"low"}'
```

mira: applied tenant ratecap -> tenant-alpha now at 15 rps. Observability: queue depth dropped 22% in 60s. p95 down to 1.6s. Good.

sam: Ben, I'll roll max_inflight change on host pool next. Doing rolling patch to avoid mass restarts.

ben: note: when reducing max_inflight we might increase per-request latency briefly while KV cache re-warms. soft-shed should target API calls with streaming attachments and rerank to avoid major quality regressions.

sam: max_inflight set to 48 across pool (rollout finished). host-07 CPU/GPU pressure reduced, p95 now 1.2s, p99 2.0s. 504s dropping.

dana: support notified affected customers (tenant-alpha and tenant-beta) with temporary rate limits, ETA for full restoration: TBD. Template used: "We're seeing elevated latency; we've applied temporary rate limits to stabilize traffic. We're working on a fix and will update in 30 mins." :white_check_mark: 

eva: logging note — creating follow-up ticket RIN-2026-507654-FIX: investigate root cause, consider per-tenant burst protection and better seq-length detection. Also update runbook with ratecap curl examples.

mira: thanks all. No page for now. Keep watch for 30m. If p99 creeps back up, escalate to infra-blitz.

ben: quick postmortem items: (1) add automatic tenant-sculptor to detect >30% qps shifts and preapply soft caps, (2) add guard for host-specific KV eviction hotness alert, (3) re-evaluate default max_inflight heuristics.

mira: noted. Closing slack thread when stable. :thumbsup:"
